script.text: @HINTS & SOLUTIONS#END:TOUCH$╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗$╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝                  $HINTS  . . . AND  SOLUTIONS, TOO $╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗╗$╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝╝Toxic Terminator features on-line hintsto keep you on the right path.  Enoughis left out to keep things interesting.This module is separated from the maingame so you will use it less often.  Ithas some suggestions on how to proceed.And for the really stumped, there aresome solutions.$▒▓ ▓▒$▒▓█▓▒$▒▓ ▓▒In this adventure, you guide the hero,Smiley Guy, as he rescues his girl friendand saves Earth from an evil machine,called the Toxic Terminator.Before he can find them, Smiley mustfind five power crystals and solve otherpuzzles.$▒▓ ▓▒$▒▓█▓▒$▒▓ ▓▒:MAINThe game breaks down into three major parts.  If you need help, choose theroom you want from the list below:!PART1;Part 1 ▐ Above Ground $ ▐                !PART2;Part 2 ▐ Under Ground $ ▐                !PART3;Part 3 ▐ Above Earth  #END:RETURN#SEND MAIN:PART1$▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀$ABOVE GROUND  $▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄!PLACE;Smiley's Place!INTRO;Introduction!APPLE;Apple Tree Lane!PARK;Sunny Dale Park!HEAD;Bio-mechanical Head!GROUNDS;Lab Grounds!FLAKEY;Flakey's!LAB;Inside the Lab!RETURN;Return to Main Menu#END:PART2$▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀$UNDER GROUND  $▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄!UNDER;Underground Cavern!TRANS;Transporter Room!TUNNELS;Tunnel Maze!MUTATO;Mr. Mutato Head!LIBRARY;Library!ELEVATOR;Elevator!INSIDE;Inside the Head!CONTROLS;Switch Controls!BRIDGE;Bridge!FOG;The Fog!RETURN;Return to Main Menu#END:PART3$▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀$ABOVE EARTH  $▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄!LIVING;Living Engine Room!PORT;Observation Port!PASSAGE;Passageways!DECK;Pilot Deck!DEATH;Death Ray!TOXIC;Toxic Terminator/Slime!ESCAPE;Escape and Beyond!RETURN;Return to Main Menu#END'     P  A  R  T    1:PLACERead the H.  It gives you all the helpyou need.  You will come back here later.!PLACE1;Can't move the dirt.#SEND PART1:PLACE1Look for something to help you.!PLACE2;Still can't get underground.#SEND PART1:PLACE2Find shovel.  Dig dirt.#SEND PART1:INTRORead the messages.  The H gives you allthe help you need here.#SEND PART1:APPLEUse your ammo.!APPLE1;Still too many.#SEND PART1:APPLE1If you find the right position underthe first trees, the apples will lineup in your sights.#SEND PART1:PARKCheck out the people and objects.!PARK1;Flicker.!PARK2;Flowers block path.#SEND PART1:PARK1Find the hidden path through the grass.#SEND PART1:PARK2Talk to Bog again.  He can help you.#SEND PART1:HEADTalk to Bog for explanation.!HEAD1;Force field blocks path.!HEAD2;How stop attack?#SEND PART1:HEAD1It can be turned off from inside thehead.#SEND PART1:HEAD2Part of the solution is in the giant head.You must find another way inside.  #SEND PART1:GROUNDSExamine the grounds.!GROUNDS1;Door is locked.#SEND PART1:GROUNDS1Talk to Bog.#SEND PART1:FLAKEYRead the built in help.#SEND PART1:LABEnjoy the shadows.  Get the shovel.Did you find the hidden room?#SEND PART1'      P  A  R  T    2   :UNDERYou are under the ground.!UNDER1;Eyes out of reach.#SEND PART2#END:UNDER1Look for loose rock.  !UNDER2;Found then lost 100 bonus points.#SEND PART2:UNDER2The points are for "persistence."Keep trying.#SEND PART2:TRANSThe H explains the three steps you mustcomplete to access the transporter.!CRYSTALS;Location of the power crystals.!CODE;How to solve the access code.!SWITCH;Where is the power switch.#SEND PART2:CRYSTALSThere are five hidden crystals, each adifferent color.!BLUE;Blue crystal!GREEN;Green crystal!RED;Red crystal!GOLD;Gold crystal!SILVER;Silver crystal#SEND PART2:BLUEAt the introduction.#SEND PART2:GREENThe flicker in Sunny Dale Park.#SEND PART2:REDThe right eye in the underground cavern.#SEND PART2:GOLDIn the library.#SEND PART2:SILVERIn the switch controls room.#SEND PART2:CODETo learn the code you must decipher thecryptic writing.  Find the book in thelibrary.!BOOK;Understanding the book.#SEND PART2:BOOKFrom the book, fill in the letters youknow in the cryptic writing.  You shouldbe able to guess the missing letters whichspell the words for numbers.!ANSWER;The answer#SEND PART2:ANSWERSelect numbers and press the enter button.The number is . . .Not yet.  Try a guess.  Then come back.Ask again if you're really stumped.#ZAP ANSWER#SEND PART2:ANSWER1459#END:SWITCHOne of the switches in the switchcontrols room.#SEND PART2:TUNNELSEach tunnel scene has different creatures.Go in and out to learn where each exitgoes.!TUNNEL1;Flying arrows.!TUNNEL2;Flies and worms.!TUNNEL3;Robo-bats.!TUNNEL4;The path.#SEND PART2:TUNNEL1Go with the flow.  If needed, shootthe yellow arrows twice.  Shooting the redwill alter their paths.#SEND PART2:TUNNEL2Shoot once to remove a fly or worm.#SEND PART2:TUNNEL3Shoot bats twice to remove.  Better yet,let them shoot each other.  #SEND PART2:TUNNEL4Going East from the transporter room,go South, East, and East to exit themaze.#SEND PART2:MUTATOWhen dealing with this creature, rememberhe is part living and part machine.!MUTATO1;How stop Mr. Mutato Head!MUTATO2;Can't get torch.#SEND PART2:MUTATO1Shooting doesn't work.  Look for anothersolution.!MUTATO1A;Another solution.#SEND PART2:MUTATO1A Turn off the machine switch.#SEND PART2:MUTATO2Access from another area.#SEND PART2:LIBRARYRead the books.!LIBRARY1;Can't find missing photo.!LIBRARY2;Don't understand symbols.!LIBRARY3;Can't read invisible ink.#SEND PART2:LIBRARY1More later.#SEND PART2:LIBRARY2Find where you have seen them before.#SEND PART2:LIBRARY3Get a torch.!LIBRARY3A;Something missing.#SEND PART2:LIBRARY3AFire it up.!LIBRARY3B;How?#SEND PART2:LIBRARY3BPut torch in flame.#SEND PART2:ELEVATORRead help first.!ELEVATOR1;The elevator stops working.#SEND PART2:ELEVATOR1After pushing the button, don't touchanything.#SEND PART2:INSIDEThe H has a tip for handling the rays.!INSIDE1;Still getting zapped.#SEND PART2:INSIDE1The pulse has a pause between colors ortwo colors then a pause.  Wait for the second color.  Move into the ray beforethe pause.#SEND PART2:CONTROLSSave game before checking out the buttons.  #SEND PART2:BRIDGETalk to the creature. You may need him.#SEND PART2:FOGYou may be able to find your way withoutextra help.  If you need help, give Bouncer what he wants.!FOG1;Can't find photo.#SEND PART2:FOG1 Find two clues in the fog.!FOG2;Clue 1 !FOG3;Clue 2#SEND PART2:FOG2At the first bugs, go East 2, South 5.#SEND PART2:FOG3At the first bugs, go West 8, South 2,East 5.#SEND PART2'         P  A  R  T    3:LIVINGUse ammo on gas.  Avoid letting the gassurround you.#SEND PART3:PORTGet key.  Take in the view.#SEND PART3:PASSAGEThe moving teeth do not hurt when you runinto them.!PASSAGE1;How to get past them.#SEND PART3:PASSAGE1Try different methods.Go above and below.  Move to open space.Bounce through them.!PASSAGE2;Other methods.#SEND PART3:PASSAGE2Push on them.  Shoot them to disrupt thepattern.#SEND PART3:DECKFind the pattern of passages to get tothe torch and the store.!DECK1;Path to the torch.!DECK2;Path to the store.#SEND PART3:DECK1Go east from red passage (in lower righthand corner of screen).  Run into wall.Bump open a path to the purple passage(third from left on bottom row).Enter it to jump to the across the room.#SEND PART3:DECK2Take cyan passage (just south of the entrance passage) to next cyan passage.Go north to white passage.#SEND PART3:DEATHGet stocked up on ammo before advancingpast the shield. !DEATH1;How to get past the ice shield.!DEATH2;How handle the guns.!DEATH3;How to get key.#SEND PART3:DEATH1Find something that works on ice.!DEATH1A;What?#SEND PART3:DEATH1AUse torch to melt the ice.#SEND PART3:DEATH2Shoot a gun twice to put it temporarilyout of commission.#SEND PART3:DEATH3Use ammo to break walls of skull.#SEND PART3:TOXICTake passage for final showdown insidethe Terminator.!TOXIC1;How to handle the slime.!TOXIC2;Can't pick up key.#SEND PART3:TOXIC1Have plenty of ammo.  Avoid gettingtrapped between slime and bolts.#SEND PART3:TOXIC2Get all three red power crystals first.#SEND PART3:ESCAPE!ESCAPE1;Can't beat slime to bonus points.!ESCAPE2;Came home.  Where's Pristine?!ESCAPE3;Can't find the Warped Zone.#SEND PART3:ESCAPE1Try changing game speed to slower.  Changeback to normal afterwards, or else, everything slows down.#SEND PART3:ESCAPE2Follow Pristine to your right.#SEND PART3:ESCAPE3After opening the wall in the Pilot Deck,arrow down at each step along the bottomof the screen.  One space will drop intothe Warped Zone.#SEND PART3
